title: FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. translated_title: FedLAFP：联邦微调中低秩聚合与全秩个性化的结合
translated_abstract: 联邦参数高效微调使客户端能够在不共享原始数据或不传输完整模型的情况下适配预训练模型，但统计异质性使得单一的全局适配器无法满足个性化预测的需求。现有的个性化方法通常在共享适配和私有适配中使用相同的低秩结构，忽视了二者在聚合和个性化方面的不同需求。我们提出FedLAFP，这是一个角色感知的框架，将紧凑的全局聚合LoRA分支与客户端私有的、具备全秩能力的RandLoRA分支相结合。共享分支为传递共性知识提供了高效的接口，而私有分支则将固定的随机低秩基与可学习的缩放系数相结合，在无需额外通信的情况下提供富有表现力的客户端特定适配。客户端和层特定的混合系数共同将两个分支融合，并且只有共享部分被……
tldr: FedLAFP提出一种角色感知的联邦微调框架，通过全局聚合的低秩LoRA分支传递共性知识，同时利用客户端私有的RandLoRA分支实现无需额外通信的全秩个性化适配，有效应对联邦学习中的统计异质性问题。
en_tdlr: FedLAFP is a role-aware federated fine-tuning framework that couples a globally aggregated low-rank LoRA branch for shared knowledge transfer with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch, enabling expressive personalized adaptation without extra communication to tackle statistical heterogeneity.
